SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-22-2021 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFFS JEFFREY GRINDEL AND BREANNA OUSLEY ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT STONEHOUSE LLC IS NOT PRESENT. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. COURT DISCUSSES WITH PLAINTIFFS ISSUES RE: PROOF OF SERVICE AND PROPER VENUE. COURT DEEMS THAT THAT CERTIFIED MAIL SERVICE BY THE AOS LEGALZOOM IS VALIDPURSUANT TO INFORMATION ON THE SECRETARY OF STATE'S WEBSITE FOR DEFENDANT STONEHOUSE, LLC. COURT DETERMINES THAT SAN FRANCISCO IS THE PROPER VENUE FOR THIS MATTER TO BE HEARD BASED UNDER THE PLAIN READING OF PLAINTIFF'S CONTRACT PROVIDED TO THE COURT FOR REVIEW. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
